arguments.sql:
SELECT s.block, s.code, s.baseSetSize, COUNT(t.id) AS translation_rows,
       COUNT(NULLIF(TRIM(t.translation), '')) AS named_translations
FROM main.sets AS s
LEFT JOIN main.set_translations AS t ON t.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.block IN ('Masques', 'Mirage')
GROUP BY s.id
ORDER BY s.block, s.code;

SELECT s.block,
       COUNT(*) AS translated_sets,
       SUM(s.baseSetSize) AS total_base_cards
FROM main.sets AS s
WHERE s.block IN ('Masques', 'Mirage')
  AND s.code IN (
      SELECT t.setCode
      FROM main.set_translations AS t
      WHERE TRIM(t.translation) <> ''
  )
GROUP BY s.block
ORDER BY s.block
LIMIT 2
